info.title: incursion-kit waitlist API
info.description:
The HTTP API of the incursion-kit waitlist server. It is wire-compatible with the legacy
community waitlist, so existing frontends keep working.

- **Authentication**: the `authToken` session cookie, set by `POST /api/auth/cb` after an EVE SSO
  login (`GET /api/auth/login_url`). Operations that need a login list the `session` scheme;
  its scopes are the permission keys the operation requires.
- **Errors** are plain text (`text/plain`), not JSON: `401 Authorization Required` without a
  session, `access denied` without a permission, `404 Not Found` for unknown paths, unsupported
  methods and malformed parameters.
- **Request bodies** are JSON; the `Content-Type` header is optional.
- **Live events** are server-sent events: `GET /api/sse/stream` (logged in),
  `GET /api/incursions/stream` (public) and `GET /api/public/stream` (public: waitlist status and
  incursions).
- **Extensions** beyond the legacy API (waitlist administration, gates, recorded invites, public
  status) say so in their descriptions; they add endpoints and fields without changing existing
  ones.

The guide to the API (sessions, roles and permission keys, live event topics) is `docs/api.md`
in the repository.

post.description:
Replaces an editable file with the request body (raw text, any content type):

- `<page>.<locale>.json`: must be a non-empty JSON object of strings; backed up, then
  written. Guide pages (and any page with `kind=guide`) go to the guide's directory.
- `languages.json`: a JSON object of code → label strings.
- A community data file: the whole data set is validated with the new file **before**
  anything is written (the legacy waitlist wrote first), then the old file is backed up, the
  new one written atomically and the new data loaded. Warnings (e.g. skill plans that no
  longer build) are logged, not returned.

Requires `commanders-manage:admin`.

`srp_setup` login (requires `commanders-manage:admin`) stores the character as the SRP service
account and keeps the admin's session: frontends that compare the state exactly with
`"srp_setup"` send it here instead of to the `GET` variant.

Month → fleet-time bucket (`a. <1h`, `b. 1-5h`, `c. 5-15h`, `d. 15-40h`, `e. 40h+`) →
pilots whose total fleet time that month falls in it. Empty buckets are omitted.

that are under 1% of x-ups count towards `"Other"` in both. A share is `null` when its
